rules.description: Update/overwrite board rules (Markdown/plain-text) or clear with null.

is_active.description: Update flag: activate/deactivate board.

IDiscussionboardBoard.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating one or more board fields/properties. PATCH or PUT supported.

All fields optional (partial update allowed). Maps to update semantics of discussionboard_boards table.

id.description: ID of the deleted board. Used for audit and confirmation in result response.

deleted.description: True if successfully deleted. For admin UI and audit trails.

IDiscussionboardBoard.IDeleteResult.description: Confirmation result for deleting a board, for audits and UI handling.

current.description: Current page number (starts from 1 for the first page).

limit.description: Limit of records per page, as requested.

records.description: Total records in the queried table.

pages.description: Total number of result pages, derived as ceiling(records / limit).

IPage.IPagination.description: Pagination information block. Contains metadata for paginated list results including pointers for current page, limit, record count, and total pages. Standard for all IPage<T> containers in the API.

search.description: Search term for matching tag names. Supports full or partial match. Example: 'economy', 'policy', etc. Used to filter the result set to tags that match the query string. Referenced from requirements: tag discovery and search UI.

page.description: Pagination: page number (defaults to 1 if omitted).

limit.description: Pagination: number of records per page (defaults to 20 if omitted).

oneOf.description: Sort direction: 'asc' or 'desc'.
Sort direction: 'asc' or 'desc'.

IDiscussionboardTag.IRequest.description:
Request schema for listing, searching, and filtering tags within the discussion board system.

Implements business requirements from tag-discovery and filtering features. All properties are atomic and correspond to independent filter, sort, and pagination criteria as referenced in the Prisma table and requirements analysis. Allows clients to search for tag records, page through results, and order by supported fields. Used for admin, moderator, and member-facing tag search APIs.

data.description: List of IDiscussionboardTag objects for the current page of results.

IPageIDiscussionboardTag.description:
Paginated result type for lists of tag records from the discussion board.

Implements presentation of tag search results (for filters, tag management, or UI chips), including standard pagination metadata and the list of tag objects. Matches IPage<T> convention, where T is IDiscussionboardTag.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for this tag record in the system. Directly aligns with the Prisma primary key for discussionboard_tags. Used for referencing, updating, and deleting tags in APIs and UIs.

tag.description: Human-friendly tag value (e.g., 'policy', 'economy'). Implements tag definition requirement from functional specs and Prisma schema. Unique per system to avoid collision, as enforced in the DB.

oneOf.description: Textual description of the tag's use, scope, or meaning. Provides admins, moderators, and end users context for how and where to apply the tag. Optional field. Used for UI tooltips, tag detail modals, and search discoverability. Matches the tag description field in the Prisma schema.

description.description: Textual description of the tag's use, scope, or meaning. Provides admins, moderators, and end users context for how and where to apply the tag. Optional field. Used for UI tooltips, tag detail modals, and search discoverability. Matches the tag description field in the Prisma schema.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when this tag was created. Used for sorting, filtering, and audit trails as required by functional and compliance requirements.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to this tag record. Fulfills audit and tracking requirements for tag modifications in admin panels or logs.

IDiscussionboardTag.description:
Discussion board tag entity definition. Corresponds to a record in the discussionboard_tags Prisma table.

Enables tag-based categorization of boards, posts, or related entities as required by functional and business needs. Each tag stores a unique, human-readable label and optional description. System timestamps track record lifecycle events for audit/logging as required in compliance. Used as a normalized element for filters, navigation chips, and bulk tag management. Each property references the field design and documentation found in the Prisma schema for tags.

tag.description: Human-friendly tag value (must be unique per system). Fulfills creation requirement in tag definitions as per specs and Prisma comments. Used to propose a new tag for use throughout the platform.

oneOf.description: Optional textual description giving more info/context to the tag's purpose/meaning. Important for discoverability and onboarding. May be omitted or null. Referenced in rich admin UI tag creation forms.

description.description: Optional textual description giving more info/context to the tag's purpose/meaning. Important for discoverability and onboarding. May be omitted or null. Referenced in rich admin UI tag creation forms.

IDiscussionboardTag.ICreate.description:
Tag creation request object for the discussion board.

Lets admin or moderators define a new tag, specifying the unique value (displayed to end users), and optionally a description. Written directly to the discussionboard_tags table. Timestamps and ID fields are generated by the backend and are not required in create requests. Follows field/description detail from the Prisma table for tags.

tag.description: (Optional) New value for the tag string (unique per system, enforced by the backend). Only present if tag is being renamed. Corresponds to updatable tag-value field in Prisma.

oneOf.description: (Optional) New or replacement description for the tag. Updates the field as documented in the Prisma schema for tags. Can be set or cleared (null).

description.description: (Optional) New or replacement description for the tag. Updates the field as documented in the Prisma schema for tags. Can be set or cleared (null).

IDiscussionboardTag.IUpdate.description:
Update request schema for tag records in the discussion board.

Allows admin/moderators to update tag value (rename) and/or its description. Fields are optional—API may permit partial update. Only those specified are altered; others remain unaffected. Matches the 3NF update and audit requirements for tags per functional/non-functional spec.

discussionboard_board_id.description: Filter by ID of the discussion board being subscribed to. Returns board subscriptions for this board only. Used to get all subscriptions to a board or for board-focused admin/mod analytics.

discussionboard_member_id.description: Filter by ID of the subscribing member (user). Returns only board subscriptions for this member. Used by profile screens and notification dashboards.

created_after.description: Filter to only subscriptions created after this timestamp. Used for analytics and recent activity queries.

created_before.description: Filter to only subscriptions created before this timestamp.

page.description: Pagination: page number (defaults to 1).

limit.description: Pagination: records per page (defaults to 20).

oneOf.description: Sort direction: 'asc' or 'desc'.
Sort direction: 'asc' or 'desc'.

IDiscussionboardBoardSubscription.IReque.description:
Request filter and pagination schema for searching or listing board subscription records.

Implements requirements for user dashboard, board following analytics, and admin reporting. Filters by board, user, or creation date. Pagination fields and sort params support large result sets efficiently.

data.description: List of IDiscussionboardBoardSubscription entities meeting query/filter criteria.

IPageIDiscussionboardBoardSubscription.description:
Paginated response for board subscription records from the discussion board.

Returns bulk results of board-follower subscriptions, including standard pagination info and an array of subscription records. Used in lists, user dashboards, and admin analytics apps. Follows IPage<T> convention, where T is IDiscussionboardBoardSubscription.

id.description: Primary key (UUID) for this subscription record. Unique per board+member in discussionboard_board_subscriptions table. Used for updating/deleting subscriptions safely.

discussionboard_board_id.description: Board being subscribed to, referencing discussionboard_boards.id. Implements business logic for linking boards to subscribers for notifications/analytics.

discussionboard_member_id.description: User/member subscribed to board (references member primary key). Fulfills per-member board following and notification requirements.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the subscription was created. Supports audit, sort, filter, and analytics requirements (as per retention/policy guidelines).

IDiscussionboardBoardSubscription.description:
Board subscription entity structure for the discussion board platform.

Connects a member to a board for notification and personalized content features. Every board subscription record uniquely links a board and subscribing member, tracking creation time for audit and analytics. Implements notification delivery, new board activity alerting, and content-follow features. Each property references normalized, atomic data as per the Prisma schema and business spec.

discussionboard_board_id.description: Target board's ID for the subscription. Must match existing board record.

discussionboard_member_id.description: Member (user) ID of the subscriber. Must reference existing member record.

IDiscussionboardBoardSubscription.ICreat.description:
Creation request schema for board subscription records.

Lets authenticated members (or admins/mods on their behalf) subscribe to/follow a specific board. Both board and member IDs must be valid and present in the system. Upon creation, automatic fields like id and created_at are managed by the backend. Properties directly reference normalized fields from schema for board subscriptions.

discussionboard_board_id.description: (Optional) New board ID to re-link the subscription. Only updatable for error correction or reassignment.

discussionboard_member_id.description: (Optional) New member ID if the subscription must be reassigned. Generally, updates to member are rare except during user merge or correction events.

IDiscussionboardBoardSubscription.IUpdat.description:
Update request schema for a board subscription record (discussionboard_board_subscriptions).

Allows modifying the linked board or member (for error correction, admin actions, or reassignments). Updates can one or both fields, always referencing schema-level UUID requirements. The id and created_at fields are never updatable via this schema.

discussionboard_board_id.description: Filter by board ID for settings. Only returns settings linked to the given board, as per requirements for per-board feature toggling.

allow_images.description: Filter to settings where image posting is permitted (true) or not (false).

require_moderator_approval.description: Filter by whether moderator approval is required for new posts on the board. Used to locate boards subject to extra moderation or to find permissive boards.

page.description: Pagination page number (defaults to 1 if omitted).

limit.description: Page size/number of records per page (defaults to 20 if omitted).

oneOf.description: Sort direction: ascending or descending.
Sort direction: ascending or descending.

IDiscussionboardBoardSetting.IRequest.description:
Request schema for searching, filtering, and paginating board settings records.

Implements features for admin board settings configuration UIs, allows selecting by image permission, moderator approval status, or targeting settings for a specific board. Each field is atomic and matches a direct column in the board_settings Prisma table.

data.description: List of per-board settings entities meeting the query/filters.

IPageIDiscussionboardBoardSetting.description:
Paginated result for board settings query.

Implements paging for per-board feature configurations, supporting workflow, admin dashboards, and configuration review. Returns 'data' array of IDiscussionboardBoardSetting records and pagination block. Used for admin tools, analytics, and system audits. Follows IPage<T> convention where T is IDiscussionboardBoardSetting.

id.description:
Unique identifier for this settings record. References the primary key of discussionboard_board_settings.

Atomic. Used when retrieving/updating settings.

discussionboard_board_id.description:
Board id these settings apply to. Must match an existing board. Enforces 1:1 mapping.

Referenced from board CRUD and settings management.

allow_images.description:
Toggles whether this board allows image uploads in posts or comments.

Set true to permit image content, false to disallow.

require_moderator_approval.description:
If true, new posts require moderator approval before becoming public on this board.

Implements stricter moderation workflows for sensitive boards.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this board settings record was created.

Immutable. Used for audit/trace/history.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when this settings record was last updated.

Enables audit trails and last-change UIs.

IDiscussionboardBoardSetting.description:
Board settings entity describing all adjustable, board-specific configuration options.

Implements customization, moderation policy, and extensible feature toggles mapped 1:1 to board records. Every field aligns with 3NF compliance and is directly referenced from the source table (see Prisma schema for discussionboard_board_settings).

Includes creation/update timestamps for audit.

discussionboard_board_id.description: Target board id to attach these settings to. Must be a valid board id and unused in other settings.

allow_images.description: Initial setting for enabling images in posts/comments on this board.

require_moderator_approval.description: Initial moderator approval setting for the board. True means every new post requires review.

IDiscussionboardBoardSetting.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating new settings for a board. All fields are atomic, 3NF, and must align with board's actual id.

No timestamps (set by server). Used in admin console.

allow_images.description: Updated value for image posting. Optional, but at least one field must be set.

require_moderator_approval.description: Updated value for moderator approval flag. Optional, but at least one field must be set.

IDiscussionboardBoardSetting.IUpdate.description:
Payload to update existing settings for a board. Only mutable fields (feature toggles) should be present.

Used by admin when changing per-board options.

discussionboard_member_id.description: Optional filter: Only list settings records for the specified member id.

receive_board_notifications.description: Optional filter: only list settings with this value for board notification preference.

receive_mention_notifications.description: Optional filter: only list settings with this value for mention notification preference.

page.description: Page number requested (for pagination). Optional.

limit.description: Number of records per page (pagination). Optional.

IDiscussionboardNotificationSettings.IRe.description: Payload for listing/filtering notification settings. Supports all indexed/filtered fields in the table: member id, notification toggles, and standard paging controls.

pagination.description: Paging information, including page number, size, total records, and page count.

data.description: List of notification settings objects (one per member, if filtered, or all in system with pagination).

IPageIDiscussionboardNotificationSetting.description:
Standard page format for notification settings results, following business convention IPage<T>.

See audit log and paging requirements for more detail.

id.description:
Unique notification setting record id for this member.

 @db.Uuid

discussionboard_member_id.description: Which member the settings belong to (reference to discussionboard_members.id).

receive_board_notifications.description: Toggles whether member receives notifications for new posts on boards they subscribe to.

receive_mention_notifications.description: Toggles whether member receives notifications when they are mentioned in a post or comment.

created_at.description: Timestamp when these settings were created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when these settings were last updated.

IDiscussionboardNotificationSettings.description:
Represents a member's preferences regarding notification delivery for boards and mentions.

Directly matched to the notification_settings table (see Prisma schema). All attributes atomic/3NF.

discussionboard_member_id.description: ID of the member for whom these settings are being created.

IDiscussionboardNotificationSettings.ICr.description: Payload for creating new notification settings for a member. Timestamps set by server.

receive_board_notifications.description: Updated value (optional) for board notification preference.

receive_mention_notifications.description: Updated value (optional) for mention notification preference.

IDiscussionboardNotificationSettings.IUp.description: Update form for notification settings, allows either or both toggles to be changed by member or admin.

discussionboard_member_id.description: Optional: filter admin assignments by specific member id.

active_only.description: If true, only returns currently-active admin role assignments (not revoked ones).

page.description: Optional: page number for pagination.

limit.description: Optional: number of records to return per page (pagination).

IDiscussionboardAdmins.IRequest.description: Request parameters for listing or searching admin assignments, with filters for member, activity, and page.

pagination.description: Paging and count information for the admin assignment query.

data.description: List of admin assignments from the search/pagination results.

IPageIDiscussionboardAdmins.description: Page result for admin assignments. Standard page wrapper with IPage.IPagination and array of admin assignment objects.

id.description:
Unique identifier for this admin assignment record (@discussionboard_admins.id).

Set by the DB at creation.

discussionboard_member_id.description: ID of member to whom admin privilege is assigned. FK to discussionboard_members.

granted_at.description: When the admin role was granted to this member.

oneOf.description: If admin status is revoked, timestamp of revocation. Otherwise, null if still active.
If admin status is revoked, timestamp of revocation. Otherwise, null if still active.

revoked_at.description: If admin status is revoked, timestamp of revocation. Otherwise, null if still active.

IDiscussionboardAdmins.description: Assignment of admin role to a member. Reflects both active and revoked admin records. Follows requirement for 3NF, audit, and RBAC.

discussionboard_member_id.description: ID of member being promoted to admin.

IDiscussionboardAdmins.ICreate.description: Payload for promoting a member to admin role. Only member id is needed (system sets grant time and id).

revoked_at.description: Timestamp of when admin role was revoked for this member. Null if admin role is still active. Correlates with role demotion, account changes, or audit requirements. Sourced from the 'discussionboard_admins' Prisma model column comment. Used to mark admins as no longer active for permissions and RBAC purposes.

IDiscussionboardAdmins.IUpdate.description: Update type for the admin assignment entity in the discussionboard domain, as per business requirements for role demotion or administrative change. Used for updating the approval status or deactivating the admin at a specific timestamp.

member_id.description: Optional filter by member's unique UUID. Used to fetch moderation assignment records for a specific user.

is_active.description: Optional flag to filter currently active moderators from those who have been demoted or revoked.

page.description: Page number for pagination; defines which result window to return.

limit.description: How many items are returned on one page (default 20, maximum 100).

oneOf.description: Sort order field. Can be granted_at (when moderator role assigned) or revoked_at (if demoted).
Sort order field. Can be granted_at (when moderator role assigned) or revoked_at (if demoted).

sort.description: Sort order field. Can be granted_at (when moderator role assigned) or revoked_at (if demoted).

IDiscussionboardModerators.IRequest.description: Request schema for searching or filtering moderator assignment records, as shown in admin dashboards or search APIs. Includes support for paging, sorting, and advanced filtering.

data.description: Paginated list of moderator assignments.

IPageIDiscussionboardModerators.description: Paginated result container listing moderator assignment entities and containing paging metadata. Used as the response body for queries against moderator records.

id.description: Primary key for moderator assignment record. Unique identifier (UUID) corresponding to the discussionboard_moderators row. Fulfills source of truth requirements for role-based API logic, audit logs, and admin dashboards.

discussionboard_member_id.description: UUID of the member assigned moderator privileges. Foreign key link to member/user record. As described in discussionboard_moderators schema, supports audit, lookup, and permission assignment.

granted_at.description: Datetime when moderator privileges were granted. Implements assignment time tracking and supports search/sort for moderation analytics and dashboard reporting.

oneOf.description: Datetime moderator role was revoked/demoted. Null if active. Fulfills RBAC audit and supports filtering for active/expired moderator records.

revoked_at.description: Datetime moderator role was revoked/demoted. Null if active. Fulfills RBAC audit and supports filtering for active/expired moderator records.

IDiscussionboardModerator.description: Main entity type for moderator assignment in the discussionboard domain. Represents assignment state for a user as a moderator, tracks grant/revoke status, and audit trail. Directly mirrors the discussionboard_moderators schema definition.

discussionboard_member_id.description: UUID of the existing member to be granted moderator status. Must refer to a valid and active user record. Sourced from the discussionboard_moderators Prisma model: supporting clear role elevation flows.

IDiscussionboardModerator.ICreate.description: Request schema for creating a new moderator assignment. Supplies the member (user) to be promoted as moderator, in strict RBAC business flows.

revoked_at.description: Timestamp marking the demotion or removal of moderator rights. Used to transition user from moderator back to member, for audit or compliance. Sourced directly from discussionboard_moderators Prisma model column notes.

IDiscussionboardModerator.IUpdate.description: Update type for moderator assignment role; used to mark role revocation or administrative status change, reflecting compliance and audit requirements.

username.description: Optional filter for usernames (exact or partial). Used for user search in admin or moderation dashboards.

created_from.description: Search filter for member accounts created after this date.

created_to.description: Search filter for member accounts created before this date.

is_active.description: Search filter: return active (not deactivated) users only.

page.description: Page number for search result pagination.

limit.description: Number of results per page, default 20, max 100.

IDiscussionboardMember.IRequest.description: Request schema for searching and paginating member accounts in the discussion board system. Primary filters include username search, creation date range, and active status, with standard pagination fields.

data.description: List of member summary response objects on this page.

IPageIDiscussionboardMemberSummary.description: Paginated container type for summary member account records. Used for listing members in search/admin views with basic metadata.

id.description: Primary key for member account. UUID assigned upon registration. Referenced for authentication, audit logs, and API lookups. Sourced from the discussionboard_members Prisma table as main identifier.

username.description: Unique login handle for the member account. Not case-sensitive; serves as logical platform identity in logins, display, and audit.

password_hash.description: Secure hash of member's password (bcrypt, Argon2, etc.), never storing clear text. Implements security policy and fulfills authentication business requirement.

created_at.description: Timestamp of member registration. Used for platform analytics, search, and audit log sequencing.

oneOf.description: Datetime when registration completed/verified. Null until confirmed by email or workflow.

activated_at.description: Datetime when registration completed/verified. Null until confirmed by email or workflow.

oneOf.description: Datetime for soft-deactivation (account suspension/deletion). Null if account is currently active.

deactivated_at.description: Datetime for soft-deactivation (account suspension/deletion). Null if account is currently active.

IDiscussionboardMember.description: Full member account entity type for discussionboard. Used for authenticated platform access and RBAC, with all non-derived atomic fields as described in Prisma. Directly aligns to core authentication/security flows.

username.description: Username to register for new member account. Must be unique across all registered members, not case-sensitive. Used as primary login and display name.

password_hash.description: Pre-hashed password for authentication storage. Never plain text; pass a secure hash (bcrypt, Argon2, etc.). Fulfills security and compliance requirements. Sourced from discussionboard_members schema business rules.

IDiscussionboardMember.ICreate.description: Request schema for registering a new discussionboard member. Accepts minimum platform credential info. Used in registration flows and admin onboarding.

username.description: Update for member's username. Must remain unique and compliant with platform requirements.

password_hash.description: Update for authentication hash. Supplies new password hash upon reset/change, per security protocols.

activated_at.description: Datetime for account activation (email/registration confirmation, used in admin actions as described in requirements analysis).

deactivated_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp; null or set for deactivation/expunge as described in business policy flows.

IDiscussionboardMember.IUpdate.description: Update payload type for member records, supporting admin/member username or password change, activation, and soft-deletion.

created_from.description: Return guest sessions created after this timestamp. Used for session analytics and marketing.

created_to.description: Return guest sessions created before this timestamp.

page.description: Pagination: which page of results.

limit.description: Results per page, limits pagination windows.

IDiscussionboardGuest.IRequest.description: Request schema for searching, paginating, or filtering guest sessions in the discussion board, supporting analytics, onboarding, and compliance visibility.

id.description: Member account UUID. Used to identify user in responses/search.

username.description: Member login handle/display name. Serves as summary identity for list views.

created_at.description: Account creation timestamp. Used in member directory and sorting.

oneOf.description: Datetime when member verified their registration. Null if not yet confirmed.

activated_at.description: Datetime when member verified their registration. Null if not yet confirmed.

IDiscussionboardMemberSummary.description: Summary type for member account, used in paginated list search results and admin dashboards to display member identities/creation dates without sensitive details.

pagination.description:
Pagination information, following the IPage interface standard. Includes current page, per-page limit, total record count and total page count.

Derived from business logic in typical paged results (see requirement 3.2 Performance & Scalability).

data.description:
List of summarized guest session records for the current page.

Each entry corresponds to an individual guest browsing session, providing only the summary fields necessary for auditing or session analytics as described in requirements and ERD.

IPageIDiscussionboardGuestSummary.description:
Paginated container for guest session summaries used in listing, analytics, or administrative reporting.

Implements the result shape for APIs facilitating guest session search, supporting all IPage features for auditing/tracking the journey of unauthenticated ('guest') users.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique guest session identifier. Directly corresponds to discussionboard_guests.id in the Prisma schema. Must be a DB-generated UUID.

session_token.description: Opaque session cookie or token identifying the guest browser. Used for guest tracking, correlation, and recognizing repeat visits.

created_at.description: Datetime guest session was initiated. Reflects guest activity timeline and supports retention/audit logic.

IDiscussionboardGuest.description:
Guest user session entity capturing individual, unauthenticated visitor sessions.

Implements the structure used to track anonymous access for analytics, up-selling, and compliance audit as described in the Actors ERD and Prisma schema.

session_token.description:
Opaque session token or cookie for the new guest session to be created.

Essential for correlating guest usage events to the appropriate session.

created_at.description: Time the guest session was initiated. Required for accurate analytics and platform onboarding logic.

IDiscussionboardGuest.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new guest session. Provides required atomic data per the Actors domain schema.

Used in registration or guest journey tracking flows, directly correlated to IDiscussionboardGuest entity constraints.

session_token.description:
New or replacement guest session token if updating session identifier (such as for token regeneration).

Mutating this is rare outside guest-to-member conversion or admin repair flows.

created_at.description: Updated creation timestamp (for migration or correction). Allows valid adjustment to guest session lifecycle if needed.

IDiscussionboardGuest.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a guest session record.

All fields are optional for partial update semantics. Used only for administrative or compliance-mandated updates. Must not mutate ID; only session_token and creation time are modifiable.

success.description:
Indicates whether the delete operation succeeded.

True if the target was deleted or already non-existent; false if the operation failed.

deletedId.description: UUID of the deleted object, if applicable (may be null if delete removed nothing or was a logical/soft delete).

IDeleteResult.description: Generic result wrapper for delete operations, indicating overall outcome and deleted entity reference for audit and client-side logic.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Used for paging through results, with first page indexed at 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page (page size). Used to control results page granularity in compliance with requirement 3.2 Performance & Scalability.

display_name_query.description: Optional filter to search for profiles by display_name using substring match or similar logic. Supports UI profile searches and filtering workflows.

created_after.description: Optional filter, limits results to user profiles created after this timestamp. Enables time-windowed admin/analytics queries.

created_before.description: Optional filter limiting results to profiles created before this timestamp.

IPageDiscussionboardUserProfile.IRequest.description:
Request body for searching or paging user profiles.

Field set implements typical discoverability/admin search features as referenced in user journey and admin UI requirements. Any property not provided is ignored or defaults to system settings. All properties optional except page/limit (required for paged lists).

pagination.description:
Pagination metadata for container (current, limit, total, pages).

Implements industry-standard IPage contract for discoverable user profile APIs.

data.description:
List of user profile records for the page.

Incorporates all profile attributes as defined in the normalized profile schema and requirements.

IPageDiscussionboardUserProfile.description: Paginated (paged) user profile result container. Used for UI tables, admin search, and batch analytics workflows.

id.description: Primary key. Unique profile record identifier. DB-generated, immutable.

discussionboard_member_id.description:
Belonged member's ID, linking profile to a registered account.

1:1 mapping with member table as required by Oracle business rules and usability flows.

display_name.description: Optional display name/nickname. Allows user-chosen public name distinct from membership username. Implements personalization & discovery requirements.

bio.description: Short, optional biographical introduction field. Used in social/discoverability views and profile UIs. Supports null or omission for users who haven't provided a bio.

avatar_url.description: Public URI (usually HTTP/S) for user's avatar/profile picture. May be null/omitted, must not contain sensitive content. Max length enforced at DB level (vendor-specific, e.g., VARCHAR(80000) in ERD).

created_at.description: Profile creation timestamp for audit and admin tracking.

updated_at.description: Last updated timestamp for version history/compliance visibility.

IDiscussionboardUserProfile.description:
User profile entity, used to customize and enhance member visibility in social/discoverability UIs.

Implements profile requirements from Actors ERD and persona/journey documentation. Distinct from membership core data to maintain normalization.

discussionboard_member_id.description:
Target member ID (must refer to registered membership).

Required for correct relational insertion at profile creation time.

display_name.description: Optional display name. May be provided at or after creation.

bio.description: Short introductory or biographical text, user-supplied, optional at creation.

avatar_url.description: Avatar/profile image URI. Optional; may be added at or after creation.

IDiscussionboardUserProfile.ICreate.description: Request body for creating a new user profile entity. All fields besides membership linkage are optional at creation time, in keeping with minimal onboarding requirements.

display_name.description:
Replacement or updated display name.

Any change is constrained by uniqueness and system personalization requirements.

bio.description: Replacement or updated biographical intro. Old text is overwritten; all newlines/formatting must comply with content policies.

avatar_url.description: Replacement or updated avatar image URI. System should validate format/safety before accepting new value.

IDiscussionboardUserProfile.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a user profile entity. Any/all fields permitted; all properties wholly overwrite pre-existing values if provided.

Used in account personalization and admin moderation interfaces.

page.description: Page number for paging through email listing, starts at 1.

limit.description: Maximum emails per page (page size).

discussionboard_member_id.description: Optionally filter emails by member ID (for showing all emails for a selected account in admin or profile emails panel).

email_query.description: Search or filter emails by substring or match logic for audit/control use cases.

is_verified.description: Optionally restrict search to verified (true) or unverified (false) emails, supporting compliance/reporting.

is_primary.description: Optionally filter for primary (true) or non-primary (false) email contacts.

added_after.description: Filter for emails added after this timestamp (audit or campaign analytics).

added_before.description: Filter for emails added before this timestamp.

IPageDiscussionboardUserEmail.IRequest.description: Request body for searching, paginating, or filtering user emails. data.description: List of user email records for current page as per request query and paging params.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique guest session identifier.
